brewing.notes: A safe starting point for dark tea: rinse once, boiling water, or simmer it the traditional way.

description:
A seed-propagated shrub tea variety with medium leaves and early budding, originating in Liubao township of Cangwu County, Guangxi.

This is a tea plant cultivar rather than a finished tea, so you are more likely to meet its name in a grower's notes than on a packet. If you find tea made from it, brew it like any other dark tea and taste what the plant brings.
history: It grows across Cangwu, He County, Mengshan and Zhaoping. It yields moderately, resists cold and drought well and is weak against mites. Little is documented about its history.
processing: A plant cultivar, not a processing style: it is usually made into dark tea, and the method is up to the grower.
harvest_season: Plucking usually begins in early April.
appearance_dry: Depends on how the leaf is processed.
appearance_liquor: Depends on how the leaf is processed.
appearance_wet: Pale green shoots, occasionally purple, with sparse down.
taste_profile: Depends on how the leaf is processed; tea from it usually falls within what dark teas give.
vintage_note: A cultivar is not sold by vintage. Tea made from it follows the usual pattern for dark tea, so ask for the harvest year and the grower.
